c.title: $4,295 / 2br - 800ft2 - Downtown Brand New Two Burrard Place | 2 Bedrooms + Den (Vancouver)
c.description:
Bright 2-bedroom + den home on the 12th floor of Two Burrard Place at 1277 Hornby Street, Vancouver.

This approximately 800 sq. ft. residence features open views, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a practical open-concept layout. The den provides additional space for a home office, while air conditioning and in-suite laundry add everyday comfort.

HOME FEATURES
• 2 bedrooms plus den
• Approximately 800 sq. ft.
• 12th-floor location with unobstructed views
• Floor-to-ceiling windows
• Open-concept living and dining area
• Modern kitchen with Gaggenau appliances and integrated cabinetry
• Air conditioning and heating
• In-suite laundry

BUILDING AMENITIES
Residents have access to Club One amenities, including:
• Indoor pool and hot tub
• Sauna and steam rooms
• Fitness centre and yoga facilities
• Residents’ lounges and private dining spaces
• Co-working spaces and meeting rooms
• Outdoor terraces and BBQ areas
• Concierge service

LOCATION
Convenient downtown location near the Beach District and Yaletown, with access to waterfront walks, restaurants, cafés, grocery stores, shopping, and public transit.

Tenant insurance and satisfactory credit and reference checks are required.

To book a showing, please reply through Craigslist with a brief introduction, including the number of occupants, occupation or employment information, preferred move-in date, and intended lease term.
